dek: The following is issued on behalf of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) has received enquiries from members of the public regarding fraudsters who impersonate the HKMA and issue a forged document about "tender of Exchange Fund Bills" under the guise of "e-HKD" related businesses.
